instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor. Analyse the company profile and survey responses, then respond ONLY with a valid JSON object containing maturity_score, opportunities, next_steps, and key_weaknesses.

answers.companyDescription: LegalTech startup providing an AI-powered contract lifecycle management platform for SME legal departments. The company automates repetitive tasks such as contract review, clause extraction, obligation tracking, and renewal management, significantly reducing manual legal overhead. Currently operating from a single location with very limited management layers, decision-making is fast and informal but often lacks the deep specialized technical expertise needed to evaluate complex technology investments.
answers.pastInitiatives: We maintain a mature innovation program featuring a dedicated R&D lab of 12 engineers and an annual budget equivalent to 5% of revenue. Over the past three years, we have successfully launched four new product lines that now contribute 18% of total revenue, including our fastest-growing AI-powered recommendation engine which has driven significant user adoption.
answers.strategicGoals: Cost reduction and process optimization are the dominant strategic priorities as industry margins are under severe pressure from rising input costs. We must systematically identify and eliminate operational inefficiencies across all back-office functions to ensure sustainable growth while maintaining profitability for our price-sensitive customers.
answers.additionalContext: The company currently faces pressure to scale R&D capabilities without significantly increasing its constrained operational budget or hiring specialized legal talent.
answers.teamSize: We have 2 generalist developers who split their time between maintaining our existing systems, handling customer support escalations, and occasionally prototyping new features. There is no dedicated innovation or R&D role — innovation happens when these developers have spare cycles between urgent operational tasks, which is rare.

opportunities.title: Workflow Automation Optimization
opportunities.rationale: Implement low-cost automation tools to streamline the existing contract review and clause extraction workflow, reducing manual effort by targeting specific bottlenecks in the stage-gate process.

first_actions: Audit current contract lifecycle pain points with customer feedback data
Select and integrate low-cost automation middleware (e.g., API integrations)
resources_needed: Subscription costs for workflow tools (<$500 annually)
execution_plan.success_metric: Reduce average contract review cycle time by 15%
milestones: Q2: Map and identify top 3 bottlenecks.
Q3: Pilot automation solution on one key product line.
Q4: Full rollout of optimized workflow across platform.

opportunities.title: Cost-Optimized Talent Augmentation
opportunities.rationale: Instead of hiring a full R&D team, focus on leveraging micro-tasks or fractional legal tech consultants to handle specific compliance monitoring tasks while maintaining control over the small budget.

first_actions: Define 3 high-value compliance sub-tasks needing external expertise
Draft a framework for outsourced task management with clear KPIs
resources_needed: Training costs for internal staff (internal transfer)
Budget allocation: $10k for fractional consultant hours
execution_plan.success_metric: Decrease external consulting spend as % of revenue by 20%
milestones: Q3: Identify and onboard first fractional expert.
Q4: Integrate outsourced expertise into the internal process.

opportunities.title: Predictive Compliance Risk Engine (Bold)
opportunities.rationale: Develop a bold, low-code predictive engine that doesn't just track existing clauses but uses machine learning to proactively flag potential regulatory changes before they impact client contracts, moving from reactive tracking to proactive risk mitigation.

first_actions: Establish a lightweight data science proof of concept using current contract data
Identify and secure a specialized advisor/partner for high-level ML architecture guidance (using limited budget)
resources_needed: External ML consultation fee ($30k initial investment)
Dedicated 20% time allocation for lead developer
execution_plan.success_metric: Achieve a successful pilot with a 70% accuracy rate in identifying emerging regulatory risks.
milestones: Q1: Secure advisory partnership and define MVP scope.
Q3: Launch internal beta testing of the predictive model.

next_steps.action: Conduct a detailed cost-benefit analysis of the Workflow Automation Optimization and prioritize the first $5k implementation.
Develop a formal talent acquisition strategy focused on fractional roles or internal upskilling pathways to address 'talent' barrier.
Initiate the Proof of Concept (PoC) for the Predictive Compliance Risk Engine, securing necessary external advisory funding.

key_weaknesses: Severe constraint on budget (4% of revenue) limiting capital for large R&D investments or hiring.
Lack of specialized in-house talent required to evaluate and deploy complex AI/ML solutions internally.
Informal decision-making structure which risks slow, inconsistent execution across formal initiatives.
Over-reliance on generalist developers who lack dedicated innovation cycles.
